verdict.rationale: Lambda publishes a REST Cloud API, with an OpenAPI spec, for creating and managing cloud resources. The docs confirm instance launch through it, including cloud-init and alternate base images. However, several documented operations are described only as console actions: firewall rules on the Firewall page, usage on the Usage page, and JupyterLab via the Instances page. Nothing shows UI-to-API parity. Missing for 10: documented API coverage of firewalls, filesystems, 1-Click Clusters and usage/billing, an explicit parity claim, and independent hands-on corroboration.
